title: Complete Guide to PHA Flats in Sector I-12 & I-16: Prices, Layouts & Rental Yields
author: Muhammad Tariq
summary: Detailed breakdown of C-Type (1,100 & 912 Sq Ft), D-Type (870 Sq Ft), and B-Type (1,496 Sq Ft) units with cash and installment payment schedules.
content: Pakistan Housing Authority (PHA) apartments in Sector I-12 and Sector I-16 have become prime opportunities for both end-users and investors seeking steady rental yields in Islamabad. With construction progressing swiftly and CDA arterial road links operating smoothly, prices ranging from PKR 48 Lac to PKR 85 Lac offer unmatched affordability compared to private apartment schemes.

title: TopCity-1 vs Faisal Town Phase II: Where Should You Buy a 10 Marla Plot in 2026?
author: Kamran Akhtar
summary: Comparative valuation between TopCity-1 on Islamabad Airport interchange and Zedem's high-demand Faisal Town Phase 2.
content: With the expansion of the Rawalpindi Ring Road and Islamabad Airport Metro link, properties situated along the western expressway corridor have seen significant appreciation. TopCity-1 offers ready possession with underground infrastructure at PKR 2.5 Crore for 10 Marla, while FT-II provides flexible 4-year installment files.
